description: Tommy's TypeScript style rules and philosophy: simple explicit code in the style of Mario Zechner (badlogic) and Anthony Fu (antfu), few abstractions and little indirection, named constants instead of magic numbers, AbortSignal on every I/O, fetch or sleep operation, object params instead of 2+ positional args, and type-safe errors as values with errore. ALWAYS load this skill before writing, refactoring or reviewing TypeScript code.
